original_test_intent: Verify that a supported primary OS can be installed onto one designated M.2, boot successfully after reboot without M.2-related errors, and leave the applicable front HDD LED off during a defined idle interval.
original_method: After destructive-scope approval, use verified signed media and an explicitly identified M.2 for a logged installation, perform one controlled reboot, prove the active boot target and storage health, then have a qualified operator photograph the physical front HDD LED under measured no-I/O conditions.
manual_activity: User approves signed media, exact M.2, data loss and boot recovery; qualified operator/KVM confirms target and physical idle LED; agent assists only within the approved installation plan and evidence capture.
required_inputs: Signed supported OS image, checksum, installer method and driver/firmware matrix
Exact M.2 serial/NGUID/slot and all-disk exclusion list
Partition table, boot mode/order, encryption and data-loss authorization
Backup/restore image, maintenance window, KVM/OOB and boot recovery
Front HDD LED applicability, vendor idle meaning, no-I/O interval and operator/camera
safety_requirements: Identify the target by stable hardware identity and display all other disks before formatting
Verify signed media and preserve existing boot/recovery artifacts
Do not clear logs; preserve complete installer, boot, kernel and SEL evidence
Stop on target ambiguity, media/signature mismatch, unexpected disk selection, partition/boot/storage error or LED ambiguity
Never auto-repartition, repeatedly reboot or treat IPMI SDR as installation/LED proof
agent_execution_scope: Collect pre-install disk, boot, firmware, health and recovery inventory
Run only the approved installer against the confirmed target and preserve full logs
After one approved reboot, verify active boot device, partitions, mounts, M.2 health and no-I/O telemetry
Do not choose the disk, observe the physical LED, modify recovery after error or issue verdict
engineer_actions: Resolve duplicate-code identity and approve media, target, destructive, boot and recovery plan
Provide qualified operator/KVM and define the idle LED expectation or mark it not applicable by platform spec
Review installation, boot, M.2 logs and physical LED evidence and decide PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: ipmitool SDR output may provide optional platform-health context, but it cannot install an OS, prove the selected M.2 boot path, detect installer errors or observe a front-panel HDD LED.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use the approved signed installer with an explicit stable M.2 target and logged partition/boot options, then collect bootloader, mount, M.2/NVMe health, complete OS logs and target-specific I/O telemetry for the operator's idle LED observation.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Single-M.2 primary OS installation, one reboot, OS-log and applicable front-HDD-LED checks plus source 10/20 timing fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Gate a reproducible signed-image deployment on stable disk identity, capture the complete install-to-boot chain, and evaluate the physical LED only during a verified idle window.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds destructive target protection, verifiable media, boot provenance and a measurable no-I/O condition while rejecting unrelated sensor output.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Optional BMC readings can corroborate health but cannot replace any installation, reboot or LED checkpoint.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Installer device names and boot order may change after reboot; stable M.2 identity and active boot-entry/root-filesystem evidence are required.

project_override_considerations: If the chassis has no front HDD LED, applicability must be documented from the platform specification; absence must not be silently treated as an OFF result.
expected_evidence: Duplicate-code resolution, approval, signed media checksum and support matrix
All-disk pre-state and exact target serial/NGUID/slot confirmation
Full installer transcript and pre/post partition, encryption and boot-entry state
One-reboot KVM record, active root/boot target and complete OS/M.2 health logs
Measured idle interval and physical front-HDD-LED photo or documented not-applicable decision

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The same code identifies row86 destructive M.2 OS installation and row434 read-only E.1s IPMI sensor validation. DeepSeek's sensor-only review appears aligned to the other variant, proving code-only identity can select the wrong test.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Composite identity preserves the installation variant. Media, target, data-loss, recovery and LED details are supplyable approvals; static review is complete.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Compatibility row86 Wistron-Storage-00069-V002: assign or approve a unique identity distinct from row434 E.1s Sensor check; provide the signed supported OS image/checksum, exact M.2 serial/NGUID/slot and disk exclusions, partition/boot/encryption/data-loss plan, driver/firmware support, one-reboot/KVM/OOB recovery contract, and define front-HDD-LED applicability plus OFF/no-I/O timing evidence. IPMI sensor output must not replace installation, boot or physical LED coverage.

review_improvement: Restores the destructive install, boot provenance, M.2 error and physical idle-LED checkpoints that the duplicate-code sensor command entirely omitted.
independent_technical_reasoning: Successful OS installation is not established by a healthy BMC sensor inventory: it requires proof that the intended stable M.2 was partitioned, the new system booted from it and storage logs stayed clean. The LED criterion is another independent physical channel and must be observed only after telemetry proves no I/O; duplicate code identity must therefore be resolved before any execution dispatch.
